items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: I come in some playing this thing, so Jell-O'-Roll Morton fell for it. Yeah. He liked it simply because the fellow that was playing what you call a cone, just a plain cone.

ctx.x: Then I made me a little invention I'd come up with. I bought a secondhand clarinet, tore it apart, and made it shaped like a bass clarinet. And I come in some playing this thing, so Jell-O'-Roll Morton fell for it. Yeah. He liked it simply because the fellow that was playing what you call a cone, just a plain cone.
Yeah, a piece of paper on it.
